decisions.reason: The resin injection unit fits the firm's core dosing and coating competence, and one year of visible market presence gives no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
A second resin injection variant shares components and sales channels with Product A, so the slack of an established medium-sized firm lets it carry the product while results are still uncertain.
Automatic airless guns are a staple of the coating-equipment range and are sold with pumps, so dropping one after a year would contradict satisficing behaviour when no failure signal exists.
Manual airless spray guns are high-volume accessory products that complete the core portfolio and are unlikely to fall below aspiration levels.
The air-assisted airless gun broadens the established spray-gun line at low incremental cost, so the firm will keep it under routine-based decision making.
The data logger is a digitalisation add-on with more uncertain demand, but organisational slack and the Industry 4.0 trend among German machinery firms favour keeping it.
